use_when: 分布式
跨设备
设备管理
UIAbility连接
多设备协同
如何发现周边设备并进行设备认证和绑定？
如何查询已认证设备的信息和监听设备状态变化？
如何跨设备拉起UIAbility实现应用间数据交互？
如何在设备间传输信息、字节流、图片和传输流？
如何使用增强连接能力实现更稳定的蓝牙连接？
如何在航空、远洋等网络受限场景下实现设备间通信？
如何申请和使用分布式设备管理所需的权限？
当你的应用需要发现、认证和管理周边设备时使用分布式设备管理能力
典型场景包括多设备协同办公、跨设备文件分享、智能家居设备管理等
开发者通过设备发现和认证后，可以查询设备信息和监听设备状态变化
当你的应用需要跨设备连接UIAbility实现应用间协同时使用跨设备连接能力
设备间登录同账号并组网成功后，可以跨设备拉起同应用进行数据交互
当需要在不稳定的蓝牙环境下维持设备连接时使用增强连接能力，适用于网络受限的特殊场景
发现附近设备并完成配对绑定 / Discover nearby devices and pair or bind them
获取已连接设备列表并监听上下线状态 / Get the list of connected devices and listen for online or offline status
在手机和平板之间同步会话数据 / Sync session data between phone and tablet
跨设备启动目标端页面并传递参数 / Launch a page on another device and pass parameters
把图片文件从本机发送到另一台设备 / Send image files from this device to another device
在设备间传输消息、字节数组和数据流 / Transfer messages, byte arrays, and data streams across devices
接入分布式设备管理实现设备发现认证和管理 / Integrate distributed device management for discovery, authentication, and device control
实现应用内的跨端接续和多设备协同操作 / Implement cross-device continuation and multi-device collaboration in the app
监听设备连接变化并在界面上显示设备状态 / Monitor device connection changes and show device status in the UI
通过 UIAbility 跨设备拉起应用功能 / Invoke app features across devices through UIAbility
在弱网或受限网络环境下保持设备间通信 / Keep device-to-device communication working under weak or restricted networks
使用增强连接能力提升蓝牙跨设备连接稳定性 / Use enhanced connection capability to improve Bluetooth cross-device stability
do_not_use_when: 需求是发起HTTP请求、建立WebSocket或TCP/UDP/TLS Socket、做DNS/MDNS解析、VPN或防火墙配置，应改用 network-kit / The task is to make HTTP requests, open WebSocket or TCP/UDP/TLS sockets, perform DNS/MDNS resolution, or configure VPN or firewall features; use network-kit instead

需求是做多路并发联网、无缝迁移、QoS评估、弱网感知或流量优化加速，应改用 network-boost-kit / The requirement is multi-path acceleration, seamless handover, QoS evaluation, weak-network awareness, or traffic optimization; use network-boost-kit instead
preconditions: 应用已在 module.json5 中声明所需分布式相关权限，且能力在目标设备与 API 版本上可用 / Required distributed-related permissions are declared in module.json5, and the capability is available on the target devices and API version

涉及设备发现、认证或跨设备连接时，相关设备已开启分布式能力并满足系统安全策略 / For device discovery, authentication, or cross-device connection, the involved devices have distributed capabilities enabled and satisfy system security policies
使用跨设备连接 UIAbility 时，设备间已登录同一账号并完成组网 / When using cross-device UIAbility connection, the devices are signed in to the same account and have successfully formed a network
使用增强连接时，蓝牙及相关系统连接能力已开启并可用 / When using enhanced connection, Bluetooth and related system connectivity capabilities are enabled and available
inputs: 设备发现或认证参数 / device discovery or authentication parameters
目标设备标识或设备信息 / target device identifier or device information
跨设备拉起所需的 UIAbility/Want 参数 / UIAbility/Want parameters for cross-device launch
待传输的数据内容（信息、字节流、图片或传输流） / data payload to transfer (message, byte stream, image, or transport stream)

postconditions.statement: 代码中已接入分布式设备发现、认证、查询或状态监听相关调用之一 / The code integrates at least one distributed device discovery, authentication, query, or state-listening call
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code/config that clearly uses distributed device management APIs for discovering, authenticating, querying, or listening to nearby devices?

postconditions.statement: 若实现跨设备协同，代码已新增或修改跨设备连接同应用 UIAbility 的调用与参数传递逻辑 / If cross-device collaboration is implemented, the code adds or updates calls and parameter passing logic for connecting to or launching the same app's UIAbility on another device
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task involves cross-device collaboration, do the edits clearly implement launching or connecting to the same app's UIAbility on another device and pass data through the appropriate parameters?

postconditions.statement: 若使用增强连接，代码已体现增强蓝牙连接相关配置或调用以提升连接稳定性 / If enhanced connection is used, the code reflects enhanced Bluetooth connection configuration or API usage to improve link stability
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task mentions enhanced connection or unstable Bluetooth scenarios, do the edits clearly add configuration or API usage for the enhanced connection capability?
